lines.text: Many learners say: My hair are brown.

native.tip: “Hair” é singular em inglês: “my hair is”.
native.caption: Cuidado com este erro comum! 😬 Muita gente diz “My hair are brown.”. O certo é “My hair is brown.”. Em português “cabelos” é plural, mas “hair” não é. Ouça o Ama e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.
native.comment: Resposta: “is”. Treine mais com um quiz grátis aqui: {link}

en.tip: “Hair” is singular in English: “my hair is”.
en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “My hair are brown.”. The right way is “My hair is brown.”. In Portuguese “cabelos” is plural, but “hair” is not. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
